title: Just on Time: Token-Level Early Stopping for Diffusion Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the inference efficiency of diffusion language models through a novel early-stopping technique called Jot. It evaluates the method using standard performance benchmarks for reasoning, knowledge, and code (GSM8K, MMLU, HellaSwag, HumanEval), but does not contain any components evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
